name: Stopwatch
tagline: Start, pause, lap, and reset an accurate elapsed-time session
description: A focused stopwatch for starting, pausing, resetting, and recording elapsed-time laps. Elapsed time is measured with a monotonic clock, so a system clock change cannot alter a running session, and the session survives a browser refresh or a container restart. Every lap records its ordinal, its split, and the cumulative total. Talome's native surface and the app's own interface control the same session.
author: Talome

volumes.name: stopwatch-data
volumes.description: Current session, lap history, and the restart-recovery anchor

installNotes: For Talome's native Stopwatch surface to read and control the session, the setting `stopwatch_url` must point at the service — `http://127.0.0.1:5012` on this host. This matches the existing `budget-compass_url` and `strategy-intelligence_url` settings. Without it, the native blocks report that app data is unavailable; the app's own interface at http://localhost:5012 works either way.
